Narrowly Missing the Mark
Jan 2025 • Couples
If I were to rate this restaurant solely based on cuisine, it would be a solid 4 stars. My partner and I both got separate set menus and each course was well thought out, creative, and delicious. Some of the courses skewed gimmicky (there was a flambe steak presentation as well as a baked Alaska torching tableside) and that energy could’ve been redirected into the flavor and complexity of the dishes. Our server was very knowledgeable—paying attention to small details—and clearly trained in hospitality. The only downside was that it seemed as though there was an illness that had circulated among several members of the staff resulting in extremely wet coughing fits. The bartender was the most affected, so much so that every few seconds when he would let out a loud, mucousy cough (without covering his mouth), the whole restaurant would go silent and look at him. To see him setting tables, making drinks, and delivering food while coughing into the open air gave us pause on ordering any cocktails from the bar. Bearing in mind that policy may prevent servers from wearing masks, this made for an uneasy experience for everyone; someone should’ve sent this poor man home for the night so he could get some rest. An added emphasis on hygiene and complex flavors would bring this chic space from 3 stars to 5.

We came here on our last night in Saigon (Ho Chi Minh City), and it was a perfect capper to our trip. The restaurant is on the top floor of a hotel, which typically would mean that the view supplants the food. Not in this case. The view IS lovely, with an infinity pool outside the floor-to-ceiling windows, etc. 

But the real star is the food and service. It is true cuisine-as art. One of the most unique and special meals the four of us had ever experienced, and we’ve been a few places! They do tableside preparations, and the molecular gastronomy aspects are really quite stunning. (We took a number of photos and videos) . There’s a reason this restaurant has earned 500 star reviews. Not to mention that the total bill, with cocktails, was $200 for the four of us. We could easily have gotten away for less, too. (Saigon is a bargain, as is this restaurant, for the quality.)

I highly, highly recommend this restaurant.

Sumptuous!
Dec 2023 • Couples
Cloud Nine's main courses focus on traditional Vietnamese flavors, elevated with attention to detail and high-quality ingredients. The caramelized pork in a clay pot is a standout, featuring tender pork bathed in a rich, savory caramel sauce. The sweetness of the caramel pairs well with the boldness of the fish sauce, creating a deeply flavorful dish that feels comforting yet sophisticated.

Another must-try is the grilled sea bass, which is perfectly cooked—crispy on the outside while maintaining a flaky, tender texture inside. The dish is enhanced by a delicate sauce that complements the fish without overpowering its freshness. The accompanying vegetables are thoughtfully prepared, adding both texture and balance to the plate.

For those seeking a taste of Vietnamese barbecue, the bun thit nuong (grilled pork with noodles) is a stellar choice. The pork is marinated and grilled to perfection, delivering smoky, sweet, and savory flavors that pair beautifully with the soft vermicelli noodles and fresh herbs. It's a dish that captures the essence of Vietnamese street food but with an elevated touch.

May 2024 • Couples
We had a fantastic dinner at Nine Cloud Saigon Restaurant to celebrate my girlfriend's birthday. The food was delicious, and the atmosphere was amazing. The restaurant wasn't crowded, likely because we visited on a weekday. The ambiance is romantic and luxurious, making it an ideal spot for a couple's fine dining experience.

Max Vu, the manager, was incredibly helpful. He received the flowers I had delivered earlier in the day and ensured everything went smoothly. He even texted me to ask for my girlfriend's name so they could prepare a personalized banner and put her name on the complimentary cake. He was friendly and provided excellent customer service.

Our server, Ann Tran, was very polite and attentive. She made sure we enjoyed our meal and checked in on us regularly. Ann Tran and Max, along with the rest of the staff, surprised us with a birthday song, a banner, and a chocolate mousse cake, which we greatly appreciated.

This place is truly wonderful, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a memorable dining experience. If you are looking for great service, this is the place to go.

San Diego, California18 contributions

Warm and friendly service staff
Aug 2023 • Business
I was only in Saigon for a day and had breakfast and dinner at Cloud Nine. Breakfast was a complimentary buffet and the selection was very decent. Their beef pho was very light yet very flavorful. Their baguette was also just how I like it, not too airy on the inside and the crust was nice and crispy. 
For dinner, from the recommendation of my server, Thai, I had the salmon cooked in a fish sauce sauce with lime leaves and it did not disappoint. The salmon was very fresh and the sauce was rich and delicious. 
But what stood out for me was the service I received both times. Their staff are so warm, friendly and sincere. Tran (I think her surname is Tranh) who served me at breakfast was just so caring when I told her my husband was ill. She wanted to send him some ginger tea, unfortunately he just couldn’t stomach anything. 
At dinner, Thai Nguyen made me feel like I was the only guest in the restaurant. He was so attentive, kind and funny, and ever ready to make suggestions. 
La Siesta is a new hotel but their staff are doing such a wonderful job making guests feel so welcome!
